about: An earlier run's pointer on the count line names idea-mara. This run's u1 (idea-tobias) and u2 (idea-lamp) both point from that line; `pointers` makes it idea-mara, idea-tobias, idea-lamp. A copy step stands in for a pointer bug that drops idea-tobias: idea-mara, idea-lamp. The real Edit guard raises pointer-mismatch on b1-u1. The rewrite gives the snapshot line's destinations first (idea-mara), then each pointer-written unit of this run in unit index order (idea-tobias, then idea-lamp), each once, so idea-tobias goes back between them, not at the end. Both units' pointed_lines become the rewritten line, b1-u1's included, which before held only idea-mara and idea-tobias. The earlier run's unit index entry is untouched. The second check comes back [].
readings: One rewrite per line fixes every unit pointing from it; the rewritten line is the same whichever unit the flag names.
